messages:
nina (Growth): quick sync: we need a fresh pass on hero copy + CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. main goals: clearer funnel separation (self-serve vs sales), short benchmark blurbs, and an inbound routing spec for demo vs trial leads. deadline: finalize drafts by Friday.
emma (Marketing): sounds good. i'll prepare 3 headline directions per page: velocity, economics, and trust. will keep lines short.
kevin (Product): Dedicated should call out SLA/reserved capacity and predictable p95. suggested one-liner: "Dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput and enterprise SLAs." Also propose a micro-benchmark: "p95 150ms for 8k context (typical gen config)" — conservative numbers only.
josh (Design): hero treatments: two-column desktop, single-column mobile. primary CTA first, secondary inline on desktop. avoid stacking both buttons on small screens. i'll mock up 320/768/1440.
emma (Marketing): hosted headline drafts:
- "Hosted API: production inference, zero ops"
- "Launch LLM features fast 12 hosted inference with predictable pricing"
- "Start building on a production-ready hosted API

Pick one and ill write supporting subheads.
samir (GrowthOps): inbound routing proposal (form + hidden fields):
```
capture: product_interest, region, monthly_simultaneous_sessions, compliance_requirements
if product_interest == "Dedicated" or expected_annual_spend >= 24000:
  route_to = "enterprise-sales"
elif product_interest == "Private" and compliance_requirements:
  route_to = "solutions-engineering"
else:
  route_to = "growth-led-sales"
```
Add tags: hosted, dedicated, private, compliance. score +3 for Dedicated/Private, +2 for compliance flag.
emma (Marketing): private page headline ideas:
- "Private inference: VPC, on-prem, and audit-ready controls"
- "Keep data in your network; maintain Redwood perf"
- "Air-gapped deployments for regulated models"
subheads should mention KMS/HSM + audit logs.
kevin (Product): benchmarks under each hero: Hosted: example latency & cost ballpark (8k context, streaming, avg token latency ~40-60ms on our verified configs). Dedicated: throughput + p95 numbers and predictable scaling. Private: call out regional deployment & SOC/ISO touches. keep copy compliance-friendly and verifiable.
josh (Design): CTA wording to test:
Primary: [Start free 12 Hosted] | [Reserve capacity 12 Dedicated] | [Request private trial]
Secondary: [Talk to sales] | [View benchmarks] | [Join webinar: production inference]
emma (Marketing): A/B plan: version A highlights economics (batching + quantization wins), version B highlights reliability & SLA. run for 2 weeks, measure signups, demo requests, and engagement with benchmarks.
samir (GrowthOps): will build routing flows in HubSpot. SDR playbook draft: how to handle Dedicated vs Private inbound (include compliance checklist). will share tomorrow morning.
preview-bot: preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/copy/1723456789-prototype :rocket:
nina (Growth): thanks team. emma drop final copy options here by EOD Thursday. josh post screenshots in #design. samir prepare routing doc + sample payloads for the form. we'll pick winners at Monday's sync. :calendar:
